About this item

  • 12-CUP CAPACITY & 2-HOUR KEEP WARM: Brews up to 12 cups* of coffee quickly. This carafe maintains heat for 2 hours (154°F). *Cup size is approx. 5 oz. (varies by brewing technique).
  • VORTEX TECHNOLOGY: The exclusive showerhead design evenly saturates coffee grounds, resulting in rich flavor extraction for maximum flavor
  • SNEAK-A-CUP: This feature temporarily stops the flow of coffee, allowing you to pour your first cup before brewing ends without making a mess. Be sure to return carafe to the “Keep Hot” plate within 30 seconds to avoid overflow, and brewing will resume.
  • QUICK TOUCH PROGRAMMING - Digital Controls let you set the digital clock and program the 24-hour auto brew feature so you can brew coffee now or later.
  • REMOVABLE FILTER BASKET - Cleanup is easy with the dishwasher-safe filter basket, which is compatible with basket-style paper filters. Refer to your user guide for more brewing techniques and cleaning tips.

Product Description

Enjoy rich flavor extraction with the BLACK plus DECKER 12-Cup Programmable Coffeemaker. The Vortex Technology Water Flow evenly saturates coffee grounds using optimal water flow for maximum flavor. You can change the brew strength for a stronger cup of coffee. Sneak-A-Cup Technology lets you pour a cup of coffee before the rest of the pot has brewed—all without any drips or spills. The digital controls feature QuickTouch Programming so you can easily set the clock and program the auto brew system for coffee now or later at the touch of a button. *cup equals approximately 5 oz. (varies by brewing technique).

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers love this coffee maker for its excellent quality, quick brewing time, and good value for money. The durability receives mixed feedback - while some say it's made of durable material, others report it breaking down after 6 months. Cleaning experiences are also mixed, with customers appreciating the cleaning cycle but noting it needs to be done frequently. Leakage is a concern for many, as the carafe drips water all over the counter, though some can pour from the full carafe without spillage.

    We initially purchased the coffee maker in March 2024 and rated it 2 stars because it worked well and then it completely failed within about three months. We're updating the rating and giving it 5 stars because Black & Decker was really great about replacing it for us and the new one has been working exactly as it should for at least a year since then. In the past, we've purchased much pricier coffeemakers, but now that we're retired and far more budget conscious, this coffee maker is perfectly fine -- even for total bougie coffee snobs. Our coffee tastes pretty great! It's a standard 12-cup model, reasonably quiet, the brewing time is reasonable, the coffee stays hot in the pot and we've had no leakage problems or any other issues. This coffeemaker really is a pretty great value for the money.

    So much better than the last pos!

    Basic coffee pot capable of making a large, hot pot of black goodness that helps me 'get through this thing called life'. I am going all the way (5 star) for this basic drip maker. Obviously you can spend $400 and get a superior machine but in the basic coffee pot category? This one is great. Our last machine was so bad we celebrated when it died.

    Our last pot went through paper towels and cuss words like they were in competition with each other. Trying to pour from the carafe was a bloody nightmare with coffee dribbling off the pot mid pour. I hated that friggn thing. So did my hubs. This pot is so easy to pour from. It makes NO MESS.

    This one is easy to pour water into the back. There is no missing the pour area unless maybe you are drunk. (Note: Resulting cup of coffee may vary if/when there is alcohol involved.)

    It has a standard reusable basket for grounds right in the front that is super easy to clean, etc

    The auto shut-off works TOO GOOD for all day drinkers. I appreciate the safety feature regardless. It does it's job. I just have to keep turning it on. That is a personal preference that has more to do with my addiction than it does the integrity of the coffee pot.

    It has a timer so you can have that baby cooking up your first morning pot while you are still drooling on your pillow.

    Anyways, Good pot, good coffee. I really hope his one lasts longer than the last one. If it doesn't, I will probably look for an upgraded pot with the same carafe.

    Good luck!

    arrived on time & packet very well. This was a replacement for an old Black & Decker, so i went with the newer basic model since it lasted so long. This is the classic coffee maker style thats been around for ever. PROS: makes HOT coffee, the donut shape hot water dispenser does very well, no paper filters have fallen over with this design, still has the timer, and the best new feature is the STRONG setting thats for making 1 to 2 cups at a time, plus it save coffee too, also when 30+/- brews happen it tells u its time for cleaning & has a built in cleaning mode. CONS: the lighted buttons glow are very dim & are especially hard to see in a bright room, the carafe or pot lid that one usually uses the thumb to push down to open the lid, your thumb has to go down into the side handle a little & its unconformable tight area especially with big thumbs. All in all its a great basic automatic drip coffee maker and i hope this one last as long as its predecessor B&D model. Would buy again.

    I have had Mr. Coffee drip makers for many years and have loved them. But when I needed to replace my old one, I decided to try this Black and Decker. It is simple which is what I wanted. I love the strong brew feature which is what I always use. And the spray water head is great because it gets water throughout the coffee grounds rather than just coming out through one little hole. But overall I am very happy with this coffee maker and highly recommend it!

About this Item

  • 12-CUP CAPACITY & 2-HOUR KEEP WARM: Brews up to 12 cups* of coffee quickly. This carafe maintains heat for 2 hours (154°F). *Cup size is approx. 5 oz. (varies by brewing technique).
  • VORTEX TECHNOLOGY: The exclusive showerhead design evenly saturates coffee grounds, resulting in rich flavor extraction for maximum flavor
  • SNEAK-A-CUP: This feature temporarily stops the flow of coffee, allowing you to pour your first cup before brewing ends without making a mess. Be sure to return carafe to the “Keep Hot” plate within 30 seconds to avoid overflow, and brewing will resume.
  • QUICK TOUCH PROGRAMMING - Digital Controls let you set the digital clock and program the 24-hour auto brew feature so you can brew coffee now or later.
  • REMOVABLE FILTER BASKET - Cleanup is easy with the dishwasher-safe filter basket, which is compatible with basket-style paper filters. Refer to your user guide for more brewing techniques and cleaning tips.

Product Description

Enjoy rich flavor extraction with the BLACK plus DECKER 12-Cup Programmable Coffeemaker. The Vortex Technology Water Flow evenly saturates coffee grounds using optimal water flow for maximum flavor. You can change the brew strength for a stronger cup of coffee. Sneak-A-Cup Technology lets you pour a cup of coffee before the rest of the pot has brewed—all without any drips or spills. The digital controls feature QuickTouch Programming so you can easily set the clock and program the auto brew system for coffee now or later at the touch of a button. *cup equals approximately 5 oz. (varies by brewing technique).
